---
# Browser tab title for the rendered HTML deck.
pagetitle: "Quickstart Deck"

# Base path used by `{{< meta asset-prefix >}}` in section files.
asset-prefix: ../../assets

# BibTeX source for `@citation` keys in slides.
bibliography: ../../refs/references.bib

# Show citation tooltips on hover in reveal.js output.
citations-hover: true

# Insert references where `::: {#refs}` appears in this document.
reference-location: document

format:
  revealjs:
    # Keep reveal's default core theme; custom CSS handles visual identity.
    theme: [default]

    # Slide number format: current/total.
    slide-number: c/t

    # Show horizontal progress bar at bottom.
    progress: true

    # Keep URL hash synced to current slide (deep linking + reload position).
    hash: true

    # Show navigation arrows.
    controls: true

    # Reveal navigation mode (`vertical` improves up/down stack behavior).
    navigation-mode: vertical

    # Slide transition style between top-level slides.
    transition: none

    # Transition style for slide backgrounds.
    background-transition: none

    # Canvas width in pixels (16:10-ish with height below).
    width: 1400

    # Canvas height in pixels.
    height: 900

    # Whitespace margin around slide content (fraction of slide size).
    margin: 0.05

    # Disable global vertical centering; content flows from top.
    center: false

    # Shared theme first, then deck-specific overrides.
    css:
      - ../styles/neutral-academic.css
      - quickstart.css

    # HTML snippets injected before slide body content.
    include-before-body:
      # Generated MathJax macro definitions from LaTeX shortcuts.
      - ../styles/presentation-macros.html
      # Preview helper to restore last viewed slide on reload.
      - ../styles/reveal-preview-restore-slide.html

    # Do not show copy button on code blocks in quickstart deck.
    code-copy: false

    # Use MathJax for LaTeX math rendering in HTML.
    html-math-method: mathjax

    # Enable reveal chalkboard/annotation plugin.
    chalkboard: true

    # Enable reveal slide menu plugin.
    menu: true
---
